A02.title: Index saved as a column
A02.diagnosis: An old row index was saved into the file as a column.

A04.title: Duplicate rows
A04.diagnosis: Some rows are exact copies of other rows.

A05.title: Conflicting duplicates
A05.diagnosis: Rows with the same features have different target values.

B01.title: Numbers stored as text
B01.diagnosis: The column holds numbers stored as text.

B02.title: Dates stored as text
B02.diagnosis: The column holds dates stored as text.

B04.title: Numeric code, may be categorical
B04.diagnosis: The numbers are codes, so their size and order have no meaning.

B05.title: Inconsistent category labels
B05.diagnosis: The same category is written in several ways.

B06.title: Mixed boolean tokens
B06.diagnosis: The column uses several token pairs for true and false.

B07.title: Numbers with units or suffixes
B07.diagnosis: The column holds numbers written with a unit or suffix (for example 1.37kg or 3.2k).

B08.title: Several values packed in one column
B08.diagnosis: Each value holds two or more numbers in a fixed text pattern (for example 3 bd / 2 ba).

B09.title: Mixed date formats
B09.diagnosis: The column writes dates in two or more formats.

C02.title: Hidden missing values
C02.diagnosis: Missing values are stored as text tokens.

C03.title: Sentinel numbers
C03.diagnosis: A special number is used in place of a missing or special value.

C04.title: Informative missingness
C04.diagnosis: Rows with a missing value have a different target than other rows.

C05.title: Co-missing block
C05.diagnosis: These columns are missing in the same rows, so they share one cause.

C06.title: Almost fully missing column
C06.diagnosis: Almost all values of the column are missing.

D01.title: Impossible values
D01.diagnosis: Some values are outside the possible range of the column.

D02.title: Extreme isolated values
D02.diagnosis: Some values are far from all other values, likely typos.

D03.title: Placeholder dates
D03.diagnosis: Some dates are placeholders such as 1900-01-01.

D05.title: Rare categories
D05.diagnosis: Some categories have very few rows.

E01.title: Constant column
E01.diagnosis: The column has one value only, so it carries no information.

E02.title: Quasi-constant column
E02.diagnosis: Almost all rows have the same value.

E03.title: ID-like column
E03.diagnosis: The column is an identifier and must not be used as a feature.

E04.title: High-cardinality categorical
E04.diagnosis: The column has too many categories for one-hot encoding.

E06.title: One-to-one categorical mapping
E06.diagnosis: Two columns map one to one, so one of them is redundant.

E08.title: Very high correlation
E08.diagnosis: Two columns carry almost the same information.

F03.title: Inconsistent class labels
F03.diagnosis: The same class is written in several ways.

G01.title: Feature predicts the target almost perfectly
G01.diagnosis: One feature alone predicts the target, which suggests leakage.
